mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month rise in FEDFUNDS signals tightening monetary policy, increasing discount rates and compressing equity valuations, leading to negative 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 1% monthly increase in employment (PAYEMS) signals strong labor market conditions, boosting consumer spending and corporate profits, which drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) despite sustained employment growth, or returns revert within 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in both industrial production (INDPRO) and personal consumption (GDPC1) indicates a robust economy, leading to increased equity valuations and positive 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: The combined effect of INDPRO and GDPC1 growth does not significantly predict positive returns (Rank IC < 0.03 over 5-year window).

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceed 4.5% for 3 months, aggressive monetary tightening raises discount rates, compressing equity valuations and resulting in negative 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) despite FEDFUNDS exceeding 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, simultaneous growth in employment (PAYEMS) and falling unemployment (UNRATE) strengthens investor confidence, driving positive 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly positive when both PAYEMS and UNRATE move as predicted (Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year window).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) of 2% over 3 months reflects expanding supply chains and economic strength, leading to positive 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 5-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) despite sustained INDPRO growth.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 1% monthly rise in employment (PAYEMS) over 3 months signals a robust labor market, boosting consumer spending and corporate profits, which drive positive 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 60-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) despite sustained employment growth, or returns revert within 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: In a prolonged monetary tightening cycle, sustained FEDFUNDS increases raise discount rates, compressing equity valuations and resulting in negative 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) despite sustained FEDFUNDS increases in a tightening cycle.
